Question ID: GEO_U03_L05_Q01

MLA Standard: Readiness Support Only

Which reason supports BC ≅ BC in a proof?

feedback.text: SAS is a triangle congruence criterion, not the reason for a shared side.
A segment is congruent to itself by the Reflexive Property.
Midpoint would need information that a point bisects a segment.
Exterior Angle Theorem concerns triangle angles.

feedback.text: SSS would need three side pairs.
ASA would need two angle pairs and a side.
HL requires right triangles.
The angle is included between the two side pairs, so SAS fits.

feedback.text: Midpoint describes segments.

feedback.text: Diagrams are not assumed to scale.

Answer order has no mathematical meaning.
